fields.name: Potential CCleanerReactivator.DLL Sideloading
fields.query: event.type="Module Load" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (module.path contains "\\CCleanerReactivator.dll" and (not ((src.process.image.path contains "C:\\Program Files\\CCleaner\\" or src.process.image.path contains "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\CCleaner\\") and src.process.image.path contains "\\CCleanerReactivator.exe"))))
